name: MV switchgear room
description: MV switchgear room for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Construction direct. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: AC metal-enclosed MV switchgear assemb — Rated voltage range
specifications.basis: IEC 62271-200:2021 scope, IEC Webstore page read 2026-11-25 (value: above 1 kV and up to and including 52 kV)

specifications.metric: AC metal-enclosed MV switchgear assemb — Service frequency
specifications.basis: IEC 62271-200:2021 scope (value: up to and including 60 Hz)

sources.note: PESTEC reference: turnkey engineering, design, installation, testing, commissioning and warranty; client Metix Malaysia Sdn Bhd.
Deltaspec portfolio item 6: one 90 MVA 132/33/11 kV and one 30 MVA 132/11 kV power transformer; client BUMISEM / SESB.

Deltaspec portfolio item 17: one 30 MVA 11/132 kV generator transformer; client TNB REMACO / SESB. Portfolio also lists rehabilitation/upgrading of the 132 kV Tenom Pangi hydro power station (item 5).

gaps.why: No MV switchgear room building cost or 11 kV panel schedule for this plant found.
gaps.next_action: Source the project 11 kV switchgear specification and an equivalent room-cost benchmark.

gaps.why: No published RM rate for the MV switchgear room; IEC price is for the standard document, not equipment, and the AED value is for a whole substation.
